# Spiral Design Report: GA-4 Touring

**Status:** Converged after **3** spiral laps.

_No narrative (SPIRAL_OFFLINE is set): every section is computed from the design state._

## Mission & configuration
- **Range:** 1,000 km with 45 min reserve
- **Cruise:** 59.2 m/s at 2,500 m
- **Stall speed:** 28.3 m/s
- **Payload:** 1 crew + 3 passengers at 86.0 kg, 50.0 kg baggage (394.0 kg payload)
- **Wing:** high wing, aspect ratio 7.6, taper ratio 0.45, t/c 0.15, CL_max 1.6, L/D_max 11
- **Propulsion:** propeller efficiency 0.8, BSFC 6.80e-08 kg/J
- **Structure:** +3.8 g limit x 1.5 = 5.70 g ultimate, spar material `al_2024_t3`

## Convergence history
| Lap | MTOW (kg) | ΔMTOW (%) | Empty (kg) | Fuel (kg) | Spar (kg) | Wing area (m²) | Span (m) | Peak bending stress (MPa) | Tip deflection (mm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1,319.3 | n/a | 740.9 | 184.3 | 38.1 | 16.49 | 11.20 | 306.6 | 540.6 |
| 1 | 1,262.3 | -4.32 | 692.0 | 176.4 | 35.7 | 15.78 | 10.95 | 306.7 | 528.5 |
| 2 | 1,256.9 | -0.43 | 687.3 | 175.6 | 35.5 | 15.71 | 10.93 | 306.6 | 527.1 |

## Mass breakdown
- **MTOW:** 1,256.9 kg
- **Empty mass:** 687.3 kg (empty fraction 0.547)
- **Fuel mass:** 175.6 kg (fuel fraction 0.140)
- **Payload:** 394.0 kg
- **Spar mass used in sizing:** 35.7 kg (statistical estimate 60.5 kg)

| Item | Mass (kg) | Share of MTOW (%) |
|---|---|---|
| Wing spar (both wings) | 35.7 | 2.8 |
| Rest of empty mass | 651.6 | 51.8 |
| Fuel | 175.6 | 14.0 |
| Crew | 86.0 | 6.8 |
| Passengers | 258.0 | 20.5 |
| Baggage | 50.0 | 4.0 |

## Wing & power
- **Wing area / span:** 15.71 m² / 10.93 m (wing loading 785 Pa)
- **Root / tip chord / MAC:** 1.98 m / 0.89 m / 1.51 m
- **Cruise / installed power:** 82.9 kW / 144.6 kW

## Main wing spar (beam theory)
- **Material:** `al_2024_t3`
- **Spar mass:** 35.5 kg both wings (17.8 kg per wing)
- **Root / tip depth:** 252.8 mm / 113.7 mm
- **Root cap:** 88.5 mm wide x 12.10 mm thick; web 2.92 mm
- **Peak bending stress:** 306.6 MPa against 337.8 MPa allowable (margin +0.10)
- **Peak shear stress:** 47.5 MPa
- **Tip deflection at 5.70 g ultimate:** 527.1 mm

## FEA vs beam theory
Solver: Timoshenko beam FEA (NumPy direct stiffness)

| Quantity | FEA | Beam theory | Agreement (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Peak stress (MPa) | 304.5 | 306.6 | 99.3 |
| Tip deflection (mm) | 532.7 | 527.1 | 98.9 |

FEA safety margin: +0.11

## Assumptions
- Cruise at L/D max = 11; loiter at 0.866 L/D max (Raymer 2ed, Ch. 3 (p. 22))
- Loiter speed = 0.75 x cruise speed
- Spar = 8.5% of statistical empty weight on lap 0 (Assumption (Spiral): not from a textbook table)
- Cruise flown at 75% of installed power
- Stall wing loading at ISA sea-level density (1.225 kg/m^3)
- Ultimate manoeuvring load factor n_ult = 5.70
- Cantilever wing root at y = 0 m; aero lift carried 100% by main spar
- No inertia relief from wing structure or fuel (conservative)
- Ultimate load = 1.5 x limit load (Raymer 2ed, p. 335)
- Spar depth = 85% of local aerofoil thickness; cap width = 35% of depth
- Caps sized at ultimate load to compression yield F_cy = 338 MPa (compression cap governs; crippling not modelled)
- Tension cap margin against F_tu = 483 MPa: +0.57
- Web: no shear failure (F_su = 234 MPa) and no shear buckling, unstiffened panel, K = 4.8 (classical long simply supported panel; Raymer gives K as a chart, Fig. 14.42)
- Minimum gauges: cap >= 2.0 mm, web >= 1.5 mm (assumption)
- Mass counts caps and web only: no stiffeners, ribs or fittings
- Tail moment arm = 52% of fuselage length (Raymer 2ed Table 6.4 typical arm ratio)
- Wing configuration: high wing
- Lofted 12-vertex tapered I-beam across 21 spanwise stations (y = 0 to 5.46 m)
- Includes 1.38x structural non-optimum mass factor for root carry-through fittings and web stiffeners
- Clamped root boundary condition (w = 0, dw/dy = 0) at wing root y = 0 m
- Timoshenko shear deformation factor Phi_e = 12*E*I / (G*A_web*L_e^2) per tapered element
- 3D von Mises stress recovery across outer flange fiber, web-flange fillet, and neutral axis

## Warnings
- Web shear buckling sets the web thickness at 14 of 21 stations

- **Spar mass:** 35.5 kg both wings (17.8 kg per wing)
- **Root / tip depth:** 252.8 mm / 113.7 mm
- **Root cap:** 88.5 mm wide x 12.10 mm thick; web 2.92 mm
- **Peak bending stress:** 306.6 MPa against 337.8 MPa allowable (margin +0.10)
- **Peak shear stress:** 47.5 MPa
- **Tip deflection at 5.70 g ultimate:** 527.1 mm

## Assumptions
- Cruise at L/D max = 11; loiter at 0.866 L/D max (Raymer 2ed, Ch. 3 (p. 22))
- Loiter speed = 0.75 x cruise speed
- Spar = 8.5% of statistical empty weight on lap 0 (Assumption (Spiral): not from a textbook table)
- Cruise flown at 75% of installed power
- Stall wing loading at ISA sea-level density (1.225 kg/m^3)
- Ultimate manoeuvring load factor n_ult = 5.70
- Cantilever wing root at y = 0 m; aero lift carried 100% by main spar
- No inertia relief from wing structure or fuel (conservative)
- Ultimate load = 1.5 x limit load (Raymer 2ed, p. 335)
- Spar depth = 85% of local aerofoil thickness; cap width = 35% of depth
- Caps sized at ultimate load to compression yield F_cy = 338 MPa (compression cap governs; crippling not modelled)
- Tension cap margin against F_tu = 483 MPa: +0.57
- Web: no shear failure (F_su = 234 MPa) and no shear buckling, unstiffened panel, K = 4.8 (classical long simply supported panel; Raymer gives K as a chart, Fig. 14.42)
- Minimum gauges: cap >= 2.0 mm, web >= 1.5 mm (assumption)
- Mass counts caps and web only: no stiffeners, ribs or fittings
- Tail moment arm = 52% of fuselage length (Raymer 2ed Table 6.4 typical arm ratio)
- Wing configuration: high wing
- Lofted 12-vertex tapered I-beam across 21 spanwise stations (y = 0 to 5.46 m)
- Includes 1.38x structural non-optimum mass factor for root carry-through fittings and web stiffeners
- Clamped root boundary condition (w = 0, dw/dy = 0) at wing root y = 0 m
- Timoshenko shear deformation factor Phi_e = 12*E*I / (G*A_web*L_e^2) per tapered element
- 3D von Mises stress recovery across outer flange fiber, web-flange fillet, and neutral axis

## Warnings
- Web shear buckling sets the web thickness at 14 of 21 stations
